title: Stop evaluation refusing a correct check when nothing changed: ordinary turns during evaluation must not void it
outcome: Stop evaluation refusing a correct check when nothing changed: ordinary turns during evaluation must not void it
acceptance: The cause of the w-e95c35f8ed70 refusal (evidence basis 239, deciding sighting at position 243, content-v1 revision against a declared git-commit input, unchanged content) is classified from source and a reproducing test, and the side that owns it is named

A positive regression shows an evaluation of a clean registered Git-input check is accepted, and done completes, when the holder's ordinary turns close with unchanged content between the evidence basis and the submission
Negative regressions show a real edit after the check, and a real edit after the evidence basis, are still refused, and that a revert to equal content is handled as the design states

A real-host run against real Engram on a disposable store shows, on the reviewed candidate, an unchanged holder close between evidence basis and submission accepted and done, a first named close accepted on both bound and unbound criteria, and a real edit and a check on another commit refused. The full ordinary-work end-to-end on Linux and Windows is criterion 5 of TermAl's w-5f8e183e1f97, and it must pass before any new evaluation window.
No existing evaluation record is modified, recomputed or invalidated, and no protection against a real source change is removed

completion.summary: Landed the registered-input witness fix at 740d4ce73ee782dc282eb297a61346719f06cd3f and installed build 0c55c89b2c23. Note-only evaluations can use a genuine registered check through quiet content reports; mutation, delayed sighting and historical-proof regressions pass. The reviewed import-only correction passed the Merger's exact-commit FULL; all six stores ready. Five scoped real-host rows passed on reviewed1ae under the recorded carry decision. Existing evaluation/seal bytes remain unchanged. Ordinary-work Linux/Windows proof and the newer live-Git currency policy remain separate.
